title: Encoding after successful decoding
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with some number of input vertices, gates in topological order, and a valid output vertex. If decoding $w$ succeeds and returns $C$, then encoding $C$ recovers $w$.
hypotheses_covered: Decoding the Boolean string succeeds with result C
